def __init__(
    self,
    model: nn.Module,
    inputs: Union[Tensor, Tuple[Tensor, ...]],
) -> None:
    super().__init__(model=model, inputs=inputs)
    self.set_op_handle(**_DEFAULT_SUPPORTED_OPS)

def activation_count(model: nn.Module, inputs: Tuple[Any, ...],
    supported_ops: Optional[Dict[str, Handle]]=None) ->Tuple[DefaultDict[
    str, float], Counter[str]]:
    analysis = ActivationCountAnalysis(model, inputs)
    if supported_ops is not None:
        analysis.set_op_handle(**supported_ops)
    
    acts_dict = analysis.by_operator()
    acts_count = defaultdict(float)
    for op_name, count in acts_dict.items():
        acts_count[op_name] = count / 1000000.0
    
    return acts_count, acts_dict
